name: Iverron's Antidote (item)
summary: In Shadowglen, Iverron's Antidote must reach a young night elf before it spoils. Dirania Silvershine brews it to counter the lethal venom of local Webwood spiders, but it lasts only five minutes.

sections.title: A Fragile Remedy
sections.body: Dirania Silvershine brews the antidote in Aldrassil for Iverron, a young night elf bitten by Webwood spiders. Its volatile ingredients and herbal catalysts give the draught a shelf life of only five minutes. Couriers must hurry north to the Webwood cave and deliver it before it spoils.

faq.q: What is Iverron's Antidote used for?
faq.answer: Iverron's Antidote cures Iverron after a toxic bite from Webwood spiders outside their cave in northern Shadowglen.

faq.q: Why does the antidote have a time limit?
faq.answer: Dirania Silvershine says the fragile draught stays potent for only five minutes after brewing. After that, its medicinal properties break down.
Dirania Silvershine, a night elf healer in Aldrassil in Shadowglen, brews the potion from ingredients gathered to save Iverron.

faq.q: What happens if the antidote expires?
faq.answer: Once the five minutes pass, the draught spoils and no longer works. The courier must return to Dirania Silvershine in Aldrassil for a fresh batch.

angles.text: As a young night elf adventurer in Shadowglen, hurrying Iverron this cure shows how the community relies on quick action and herbal knowledge against corruption in Teldrassil's boughs.
As an herbalist, you can see how volatile native Teldrassil reagents make some remedies that must be used at once.
